## [1.6.1](https://github.com/ahmedyarub/morphe-patches/compare/v1.6.0...v1.6.1) (2026-09-21)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **Instagram:** Collapse duplicate 447 target to build 385311927 ([056e323](https://github.com/ahmedyarub/morphe-patches/commit/056e323504470910f7e5c9653efde5d47518c851))
* **Instagram:** Support 447.0.0.55.81 build 385311927 ([256fd62](https://github.com/ahmedyarub/morphe-patches/commit/256fd62002528e79f2b43d3f189505bdf329d36d))
* **Instagram:** Support 447.0.0.55.81 build 385311927 ([0c7c67c](https://github.com/ahmedyarub/morphe-patches/commit/0c7c67cb75cd032d43a3c4e05a131dd991af3327))

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Blocks analytics requests sent to Instagram and Facebook servers.

patches.name: Disable screenshot detection
patches.description: Disables screenshot detection in direct messages and stories.

patches.name: Download media
patches.description: Adds ability to download posts, reels, stories and highlights

patches.name: Download voice message
patches.description: Enables ability to download voice messages

patches.name: Filter stories
patches.description: Hides categories of stories from the story tray.

options.description: Hides advertisements from the story tray.
Hides suggested users and creators from the story tray.
Hides resurfaced highlights from the story tray.

patches.name: Hide Threads profile button
patches.description: Hides the Threads button from the profile page action bar (top right of the profile page).

patches.name: Hide suggested content
patches.description: Choose the suggested content to hide using the patch options.

options.description: Hides suggested reels from feed and reels tab.
Hides suggested stories/users from story tray.
Hides highlighted stories from story tray, sponsored stories which have no set expiration.
Hides suggested accounts from the list of followers and from other profiles.

patches.name: Improve image viewing
patches.description: Requests the maximum resolution images from the server.

patches.name: Make ephemeral media permanent
patches.description: Changes unexpired view once, view twice media to permanent view.

patches.name: Open links externally
patches.description: Opens links in the system browser instead of the in-app browser.

patches.name: Sanitize share links
patches.description: Removes tracking parameters from links shared out of the app.

patches.name: Save deleted messages
patches.description: Captures incoming DMs locally as they arrive from the server and marks them when the sender deletes them.

patches.name: Remove Reddit Pro section
patches.description: Removes the Reddit Pro section from the community drawer, and the Reddit Pro promos: the post creation and subreddit join upsell sheets, and the Reddit Pro banner on the profile feed.

patches.name: Remove Resources and Games on Reddit sections
patches.description: Removes the Resources and Games on Reddit sections from the community drawer.
